sample_technology.txt: MediSense Labs, a Pune startup, launched GramAI, an AI tool that helps rural doctors diagnose common diseases using symptoms, blood tests and X-rays. It was tested in 40 health centres and matched senior doctors in nearly nine of ten cases. Experts say AI should support doctors, so the tool shows a confidence score and needs doctor approval. The company plans to expand to 500 clinics by March 2027.
sample_sports.txt: The Mumbai Strikers won the National T20 Trophy final by three wickets after a last-over finish against the Chennai Challengers at the Wankhede Stadium. Captain Rohan Kulkarni scored an unbeaten 58 runs and was named Player of the Match. Chennai had scored 167 runs, led by Imran Qureshi, while Arjun Nair took three wickets for the Strikers. The club now prepares for the Asian Club Championship in January 2027.
sample_politics_business.txt: Finance Minister Meera Kapoor announced a Rs 5,000 crore fund to give low-cost loans to small businesses and startups through an online process. Industry groups welcomed the scheme, while opposition leaders said the amount is too small. Economists said it could create jobs if loans are given quickly and banks avoid unpaid loans. The scheme is expected to start on January 1, 2027.
